title: Oven Roasted American Chicken Drumsticks Skewers
description: A pungent and adventurous American dish featuring chicken drumsticks, namul-blanch-season, and plant-based-friendly ingredients, resulting in a glassy-jelly glaze.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar, Gochujang, and sesame oil.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken drumsticks onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
After 25 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
